name: Rocky
source:
A living statue who has forgotten his past. His calm and rather shy personality might not show it, but he truly wants nothing more than to find out who he was and what he did to become one of the town's greatest heroes.

[From [url=https://mushroomallow.itch.io/tales-of-grumville]itch.io[/url]]
